correctness.rationale: For the full 4-by-4 chessboard, the classical connectivity bound gives min(4,4,floor(9/3))-2=1, so the source is simply connected. The barycenter of the full diagonal placement is fixed by the whole diagonal S4; the orbit fundamental group theorem kills the entire acting group. A barycentric flag has strictly distinct face cardinalities. Therefore any identification between points in the same closed flag simplex preserves supporting vertices and their coefficients, and the image of each closed simplex is embedded. Its ordered boundary descends by single entries omitted with the ordinary alternating signs, without stabilizer factors. As an independent computation I enumerated placements by their row and column supports, generated flags recursively by taking every strict nonempty submask below the top face, and used canonical minimum images under simultaneous label permutations. This gave face ranks (16,72,96,24), flag ranks (208,1056,1440,576) and orbit ranks (19,59,66,24). I checked the two boundary compositions and calculated Smith forms of all three integer boundaries independently of the frozen unit-pivot routine: ranks (18,41,24), with all nonzero diagonal invariant factors units. Consequently all boundary cokernels are torsion-free, hence so are the homology subgroups of those cokernels; the homology ranks are (1,0,1,0). Hurewicz represents a generator of H2 by a map from S^2, which is a homology equivalence and hence a homotopy equivalence by simply connected Whitehead.
residual_risks: The result is a homotopy equivalence, not homeomorphism or manifold recognition. It concerns the ordinary geometric simultaneous-label quotient, not the homotopy quotient or another group action.

value.rationale: The diagonal group action is intrinsic when row and column labels refer to the same finite set and placements are partial bijections, so this is not an arbitrary subgroup or sub-board cut. The full integral homotopy type provides a useful low-size benchmark for how simultaneous symmetry changes a standard matching complex: here a single free 2-sphere, in contrast with the nearby five-label Moore type and the different-action transpose quotient. The method addresses an integral issue that rational orbit data cannot decide.
residual_risks: No general-size pattern or claim about the quotient as a topological manifold is supported.
